description: Two or three sentences. What the shape is, what it is made of, and why people miss it.

whereToLook.scene: The larger scene or prop the guest should locate first
whereToLook.exactSpot: The precise spot within that scene

bestTip: One sentence on timing or positioning that makes this easier to spot.
funFacts: Optional. Trivia or history that makes the find more satisfying.

image.alt: Required. What the photo shows, for screen readers. The file named above goes in content/images/.
